title: Heated Pool & Putting Green: Chandler Home!
description:
Outdoor Living Space | 4,027 Sq Ft | Covered Parking

This stunning Chandler vacation rental features 6 bedrooms, 4.5 baths, and top amenities. The backyard is a true oasis with an in-ground pool, patio, and gas grill. To top it all off, the home is close to downtown Phoenix, golf courses, hiking trails, and Spring Training stadiums. Everything you need to have an unforgettable experience is nearby!

 The space 
TPT-21664350

SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS
- Bedroom 1: 1 king bed, 1 full sleeper sofa
- Bedroom 2: 1 king bed
- Bedroom 3: 1 king bed
- Bedroom 4: 1 king bed
- Bedroom 5: 1 king bed
- Bedroom 6: 2 queen beds
- Additional Sleeping: 1 portable crib, 2 rollaway beds

OUTDOOR LIVING
- Private pool
- Covered patio w/ dining table
- Gas grill
- Fenced yard
- Covered seating area w/ cushioned seating & fire pit

KID FRIENDLY
- Toys & books
- High chair, dinnerware

INDOOR LIVING
- 6 flat-screen Smart TVs & Hulu w/ live TV
- Fireplace, board games
- Formal dining table
- Family room, living room
- Wet bar w/ wine refrigerator
- Laptop-friendly workspace
- En-suite bathroom w/ walk-in shower & soaking tub
- Foosball table, ping-pong table, air hockey table, pool table, cornhole, Connect 4

KITCHEN
- Stainless steel appliances
- All major appliances w/ dishwasher
- Keurig & electric water heater
- Dishware & flatware
- Island w/ seating

GENERAL
- Free WiFi
- Linens/towels
- Ceiling fan
- Washer/dryer
- Complimentary toiletries

ACCESSIBILITY
- Stairs required

FAQ
- Optional $35 nightly pool heat fee (+ fees & taxes, paid pre-trip, applied to entire stay)

PARKING
- Garage (3 vehicles)

 Guest access 
Guests will have access to the entire property via keyless entry

 Other things to note 
- No smoking
- No pets allowed
- No events, parties, or large gatherings
- Additional fees and taxes may apply
- Photo ID may be required upon check-in
- NOTE: Your safety matters. This property features 1 exterior security camera. This device may be recording activity for your safety, but should not infringe on your privacy
- NOTE: Stairs are required for access
- NOTE: The property can sleep 16 guests in 8 beds, with room for 2 additional guests using the twin rollaway beds
